_comment: Loaded when ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Testing, i.e. by the WebApplicationFactory-based integration tests (tests/Booksy.Host.IntegrationTests/Infrastructure/BooksyHostFactory.cs, tests/Booksy.Host.IntegrationTests/Composition/HostCompositionFactory.cs). Connection strings are injected by the factory from Testcontainers; everything else that used to be a UseSetting call lives here so the test configuration is a file, not code.

Database._SeedReferenceData: Off here only for host boot speed: every test TRUNCATEs every table first anyway, and no test depends on the thousands of province/city rows. Production leaves it at its default (true).
